What each line answers

Line 1
The Trade
What's the call and what's the trade? Verdict + tier + BAP + entry/stop/T1/T2 + R:R + warning + mode toggle. 95% of decisions made from this line alone.
Line 2
The Context
Why this call, how confident? Setup family + alignment summary + 8 lens chips + ER buffer + Kelly multiplier + freshness. Scan when verdict isn't obvious.
Line 3
The Spatial View
Where is price RIGHT NOW relative to the plan? The ladder visually shows: ALB price is below the entry zone · still above stop · long way to targets. Eye reads asymmetry instantly. The bottom R:R strip shows: tiny red sliver vs huge green band = 1:3.6 R:R proportionally.
Why the ladder is the killer add-on
For ALB, the screener says WAIT — and the ladder shows you exactly why at a glance: the white NOW dot sits between the red stop dot and the green entry zone. Price is below the entry zone. The trade isn't dead — you're waiting for the retest back up into entry. Single line of text could never communicate that as fast as a 1-second eye-scan of the ladder.
